context-arithmetic.totalSS: sum unordered pair squared mean differences divided by N
context-arithmetic.withinSS: sum corresponding SS within exact binary64 jitter/reset groups

limitations: Sixteen captures estimate empirical baseline repeatability, not statistical significance/error bounds
Weather/calendar control does not freeze dynamic lighting, physics or temporal history
Different stage resolutions/formats prevent treating cross-stage sample deltas as a pure brightness transform
FSR autoExposure/highDynamicRangeInput flags do not expose Skyrim HDR internals or OS Auto HDR
One interior, one upscaling preset, no RS comparison
No performance cost measurement or isolated shader study
Sampled FSR output and combined-copy means are duplicated observations, not independent experiments

method.coordinateConvention: crop-local integer inclusive stratification; origin separately retained
method.proxy: Rec.709 weighted format-native decoded channels, no transfer conversion; not display luminance
